current_text: You wake face-down in a haybale at the Compost Grange. Granny Gristle is leaning on a pitchfork, chewing a stalk of something.

current_text: "Fell over in the muck, dearie. We rolled you out. The mucking-out fee's on you. Heh!

current_text: Don't take it personal. The haybale was free. The haybale's also, I think, growing."
new_text: Haybale was free. Mind you, it is growing. Best get up before you put down roots."
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

current_text: The animals fall on the junk, chew it thoughtfully, and spit out a coin. Gold!

speaker: (narration)

current_text: You plant a crop and pat the soil. It wriggles a little. Come back in a bit and it will be ready.

current_text: The crop is still growing. A sprout waves at you. Do not wave back. It gets ideas.
new_text: The crop is still growing. A sprout waves at you. You give it space; it seems rather attached to the plot.

current_text: A ripe harvest! Pumpkins, melons, one suspicious turnip.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The goat looks at you, looks at the pen, looks at the sign it was eating, and trots home. Round one: you.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The pig is exactly where you expected, in the only puddle. A little shoving and it waddles home, offended.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The raccoon takes one look at you and walks to the pen on its hind legs, holding a tin can like a briefcase. It is already negotiating.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: That one is already back in the pen. It is sulking. It will get over it.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The vine bridge sways and creaks cheerfully. It is made of vines, ambition and a lot of compost.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The seed cracks. The soil heaves. Green shoots race into the air, twisting and knotting...

speaker: (narration)
current_text: It has grown! It looks like it was always there, which is what every druid says.
new_text: It has grown! You try to picture the spot without it. The druids look pleased with themselves.

current_text: You climb the beanstalk, hand over hand. The leaves are big enough to sit on. Do not sit on them.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You slide down the beanstalk. Leaf, leaf, leaf, ground. It is faster than the chute and much less dignified.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You swing up onto the saddle. Faster, and it can smash junk barricades. Press Q to dismount.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You hop off and the animal trots back to its stable, snorting.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You cannot dismount out here, the scree will eat your boots. Find a flat spot first.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A barricade of junk. Far too heavy to push on foot. Something fast and stubborn could charge through it.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: KA-RASH! Tyres fly, doors fly, and a very surprised hubcap lands in the pen. The way is open.

speaker: (narration)

speaker: (narration)
current_text: WHEEEEE!
